name: Lil Coulier
source:
One of Till's classmate and Sefi's friend, Lil is one of the first "Gun Knights" of Equites. 

[spoiler]Lil is Sefi's bodyguard as she already graduated as a Seikishi.  She hides her true strength in order to carry her duty without suspicion.[/spoiler]
